༄༅/ /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba

zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / shog skya'i skor/ mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rin chen drwa ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi thugs rje shin tu rmad byung ba/ /dgung zla'i 'od las ches dkar rab 'phro bas/ /ma rig mun sel 'gro kun mtshan mo'i mig /thar gling snang bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bde legs phun tshogs kyis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lus bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ /dri med 'od zer bzang pos snang bar byas/ /'dir rang ngam gzhan gyi don du tshwa tshwa bzheng par 'dod na/ gtor ma byin nas sa blangs te/ āoṃ badzra kha na kha na hūṃ gis rin po che'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs la/ āoṃ badzra mu ka ra a ko tra yā hūṃ gis brkos nas 'jim par g.yos la/ de'ang tshe 'das pa'i ched yin na/ rus pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i dbus su a dkar po las bdud rtsi babs pas sdig pa dag par mos shing rigs lnga'i sngags zlos shing*/ dri bzang po'i chus bkrus pa'i mthar āoṃ pra mar dha na ye swā hās sgrib pa dag par bsams la zhib par brdungs te/ 'jim pa dang bsres la/ pad zla'i steng du 'jim pa'i phung po de nyid bhruṃ las rin po che'i phung por bsams la/ skad cig gis bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsams pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer 'og min gyi rnam par snang mdzad la phog pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas 'jim pa la phog pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bong gis mnan nas gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byas la kha sbub la/ āoṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bha ra dza yāḥ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar ha te saṃ myag saṃ bhuddha ya/ tadya thā/ āoṃ sukṣa me sukṣa me/ sa ma ye sa ma te/ shan te dhante/ a na ya a laṃ bhe/ ta raṃ bhe/

ya sho ba ti/ mahā te dza nir ku la ni ra bha ni/ sarba ta thā ga ta hrid da ya/ a dhi tiṣṭha na/ a dhi tiṣṭha te swāhā/ zhes bdun brjod nas/ na maḥs manta/ bhuddha nan/ āoṃ badzra ā yu she swā hās 'jim pa snyoms par bcad pa'i nang du/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ la sogs pa'i gzungs gzhug ni/ āoṃ badzra dharma dhārtu gharbhe ye swā hā sa gzhug go /oṃ badzra dzrod bha wa swā hās 'bi 'bi byas la/ āoṃ badzra ā ra dze wa ra dze swā hās snum bskus la/ āoṃ dharma dhārtu garbhe ye swā hās kol phor du bcug la/ āoṃ badzra mud ka ra a ko tra ye swā hās kol phor brdung nas/ āoṃ badzra dharma ra te swā hās phyung la/ āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma kā ya ma hā su kha/ badzra su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis chos skur bsams pa'i ngang las/ āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ bho kā ya st+waṃ gyis longs skur byon te/ āoṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma kā ya sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis sprul skus sems can gyi don byed par bsams la brai mthun par bsgrigs te gdab bo/ /de dag gi mdun du mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gsum bshams la/ 'bru'i snod gnyis kyang sta gon du bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'og ma gnyis bgegs dang gzhi bdag la bsngos te bka' bsgo byas la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du dmigs la mchod bstod byas la/ snod kyi nas gcig la rigs lnga'i sngags dang*/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas so/ /de nas/ āoṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngag las paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ bhruṃ las rin po che'i mchod rten/ gdan khri ri rab bum pa bre 'khor lo bcu gsum/ gdugs char khebs tog dang bcas pa'i bum pa ma gtogs pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang bum pa mthing ga'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang chen/ lhor rta mchog /nub du rma bya/ byang du shang shang gi khri'i steng du padma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/

āoṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥlnga las/ rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed la/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ gis sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs la/ langs te me tog 'thor zhing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma gzhag gi bar du/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du bzhugs nas/ gang gis mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ reg pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ āoṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ āoṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ āoṃ ye dharma he tu pra bha wa he dunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rad na ke tu rā dza yā/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar ha te saṃ myag sam buddha ya/ tadya thā/ āoṃ rad ne rad ne ma hā rad ni/ rad na bi dza ye swā hās bskor ba bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bton nas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung chen por bsams te/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /me tog ji snyid yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ / mgon po sras dang bcas la 'bul/ āoṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du mchod pa lhag ma'ang 'gres mthun par 'bul/ 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig po lum par bltams/ /ser skya'i grong khyer gcig tu gnas mdzad cing*/ /yon tan rin chen bye bas brgyan pa yi/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ga ta yi byang chub shing gi drung*/ /chu bo nai rañdzu ra zhes bya ba'i/ / 'gram bzhugs mchod rten yon tan rgya che bas/ /byang chub rten du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ka shi ka yi wā rā na sī ru/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol rmad byung bas/ /nyon mongs sgrib kun rnam par sbyangs mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mchod rten bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyan du yod par gzhan stobs tshar bcad nas/ /dze ta'i tshal du cho 'phrul chen po yis/ /sa gsum dgongs pa mchog tu bsgrubs mdzad pa/ /mu stegs pham mdzad mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong khyer dam pa mchog ni gsal ldan du/ /lha rnams gshegs te bla na med pa yi/ /zhabs la tshangs dbang cod pan gyis mchod pa/ /sum cu'i lhas mchod mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun dbyen bsdum snga gyur te/ ston pa'i nyan thos rab 'dum pa/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal/ /byams pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba las/ /slar yang sku tshe byin brlabs shing*/ /rnam grol yangs pa can gyi tshal/ /byin rlabs mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku sha'i grong du 'gro ba rnams/ /dge ba la ni sbyor mdzad cing*/ /'gran med gyad rnams bzung ba'i tshal/ /mchod rten myang 'das phyag 'tshal lo/ /shāka thub mchod rten brgyad po dang*/ /phyogs bcu gzhan dang gzhan rnams na/ /bzhugs pa'i mchod rten kun la 'dud/ /gzhi la rtag tu spyis phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod nas me tog bkram ste/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ /mchod rdzas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol lo/ / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la/ /thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ /skyob pa'i nus mthu la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang*/

/thugs dam dang*/ /rtogs pa dang*/ phrin las la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing gong nas gong du 'phel bas/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /bdag cag chos sgrub pa po rnams kyi/ chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bar du gcod pa zhi nas/ ci bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad chos ldan du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang lo phyug rtag tu legs shing*/ phyi 'khrugs dang*/ nang 'khrugs dang*/ mtha' dmag dang*/ sad ser dang*/ mu ge dang*/ gnod 'tshe thams cad med cing bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /ci bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad chos ldan du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes pa gsum gyis me tog 'thor ro/ /tshe 'das kyi yin na che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di'i sa dang lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gtor ma de nyid/ dpa' mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la/ a kā ros bsngos la/ rten 'di la phyi nang gi gnod pa dang 'tshe ba la sogs pa thams cad med par mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas rdo rje'i glus shes pa brjod par bsams la/ me tog 'thor zhing mgrin gcig tu/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la rtag tu zhi byed pa/

/bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis legs par gsungs pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*/ bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs las grol ba dang*/ /mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung 'gyur pa'i/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang*/ /bzod pa sgom zhing rtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lug rtogs gyur pa'i/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ /don yod grub bcas rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /āoṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hās brtan par byas te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/

/bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rgas na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces brjod la stan la 'khod la dga' ston bya'o/ /gangs ri'i ngos la bdud rtsi'i chu babs pas/ /yid 'ong bya tshogs mang po dga' ba ltar/ /bdag blo'i legs bshad padma'i gangs can mtsho'i/ /rigs ldan skye bo'i ngang pa dga' bar mdzod/ / 'di ni rgyun don snying papo'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /dri med 'od zer deng sang shar ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying tig zab mo'i cha can du/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /'od gsal snying po'i de nyid legs gzigs nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /gdod ma'i gnas su lhun gyis grub par shog / mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rin chen dra ba zhes bya ba padma las 'brel rtsal gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge legs so// //madga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba/ -PAGE 342--PAGE 343--PAGE 336-
